name: Natsuki and Chill
source:
After telling her that you're interested in her, Natsuki wants to come to your place! Spend a chill evening with her... And maybe get a little more intimate...

[From the [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/DDLCMods/comments/pnfv8l/comment/hcoviqu/]fan game page on Reddit[/url]]
translation:
在你向夏树表明心意之后，她想来你家做客！与她共度一个轻松惬意的夜晚吧……或许，还能变得更亲密一点……

[摘自[url=https://www.reddit.com/r/DDLCMods/comments/pnfv8l/comment/hcoviqu/]Reddit上的同人游戏页面[/url]]
